entries.test: client-urls-vars.test.ts > clientUrls middleware vars > a createVar token and a string key reach a group loader on the document and partial lanes
entries.reason: Undeclared, cause: a clientUrls() navigation renders the destination first with a never-settling gate per loader (PENDING_FOREVER, src/client-urls/client-root.tsx:30, :152-178) and the reader mounts suspended on it. When the server's answer has settled before the canonical tree renders, useLoader finds a settled value in loaderStreams (src/use-loader.tsx:54-65) and calls no use() at the same key path, which React reports as a conditional use(). Timing-dependent. The gate-then-value hand-over of the clientUrls one-commit cases (#1079). Reproduced on origin/main.

entries.test: suspense-cases.test.ts > suspense cases (dev) > an action refetch, a refresh and a back/forward restore keep every wrapper chain
entries.reason: #1079, rule 2 after #1080: on the refresh, renderSegments builds the tree while the shell layout's loader data is still pending (src/segment-system.tsx:604), so getMemoizedLoaderPromise hands the loader boundary the aggregate promise (src/segment-loader-promise.ts:134). When React renders that boundary only after the aggregate has settled, LoaderResolver (src/route-content-wrapper.tsx:330) is handed a settled promise React has not read. Measured with 4x CPU throttling: the loader data fulfilled 13 ms after the build and the boundary rendered 94 ms after it, 6 of 6 runs; 0 of 64 unthrottled at load 12, 5 of 5 at load 20-50. The refresh commits in a transition, so nothing shows (no fallback counted). Timing-dependent.
